lines.text: Why won't Lulu reply to my toasts...? Is she still angry?
What should I do...? Maybe I should apologize to her in person...
Are you ... Old Tianshi Gu's disciple? I, uh, had a big fight with Lulu. Her full name's Ning Lu. We're dating but...

Lulu wants to stay at the Blight Monitoring Zone and I couldn't persuade her to leave... Things got a heated. I said something really stupid and she left angrily. Now Lulu won't even respond to my toasts...
I don't know what to do... Maybe I should go and meet her. But if she's still mad, I'll end up making her more upset...
I'm super worried right now. If she's in trouble ... I'd never be able to forgive myself...
Thank goodness we argued about this. Things would be worse if he joined the mission...
But ... I really want to see Chao again...
You're that ... young disciple of Master Gu? I didn't expect you to come and save me. Thank you...
Yeah. An Chao is his full name. He's my partner and we're dating... We also had a big argument because I refused to evac from my post.
He got a little desperate and called me an "angry stubborn burdo". I pretended to be angry and left in a huff because ... I didn't want him to follow me here.
This mission is also very dangerous. He would've never let me come here alone.
Hurhur. We do have the same personalities... He's probably worried about me and blaming himself for making me angry...
Even I wouldn't know what to say if he shows up...

options: Are you alright? You need treatment!
Don't worry about it. Did you mention someone named Chao?
Why don't you just say you care about each other out loud?
I see. Maybe that's why you two started dating...
